objective.name: request
objective.description: Provider-agnostic contract of an inference request addressed to this LLM context.

functional._messages_comment: Ordered array of already-prepared messages forming the inference input. Each message carries a role and content. The LLM context receives the cognitive input already prepared. A message may carry cache: true, a provider-neutral hint that it ends a stable prefix reused across inferences; a provider without explicit caching ignores it. The content of a message is a string, or a list of blocks when native tools are used: {type: text, text}; {type: tool_call, id, name, arguments} in an assistant message; {type: tool_result, call_id, content, is_error} in a user message, placed before any other block of that message, one for each tool_call of the preceding assistant message; {type: provider_block, provider, block}, an opaque block a provider returned (for example a thinking block), sent back unchanged to that provider only.
functional._metadata_comment: Optional free object describing the request for whoever observes it (for example the continuity and the step that asked). No provider adapter reads it: it is never sent to a provider.

parameters._temperature_comment: Optional generation temperature when supported by the resolved model.
parameters._top_p_comment: Optional nucleus-sampling parameter when supported by the resolved model.
parameters._max_output_tokens_comment: Optional maximum number of tokens requested for the generated output.

requirements._provider_comment: Optional provider constraint. When absent, any compatible provider may be resolved.
requirements._model_comment: Optional explicit model constraint. When absent, an appropriate model may be resolved.
requirements._capabilities_comment: Optional characteristics required from the model and used during model resolution.
requirements._reasoning_comment: Optional requested reasoning characteristic or level, translated by the provider adapter when supported.

output._format_comment: Requested representation of the generated output.
output._schema_comment: Optional structured-output contract when constrained structured generation is required.

functional._tools_comment: Optional native tools offered to the model: a list of {name, description, input_schema}. Names are provider-safe ([a-zA-Z0-9_-], at most 64 characters). Only a provider qualified for native tools accepts them (root/mcp/document/provider_qualification.md); the others refuse the request (reason tools_not_supported), never drop the tools.
functional._tool_choice_comment: Optional, with tools or with a history of tool blocks: auto (default) lets the model call a tool; none forbids it, for a turn that must answer (a compaction) while keeping the same tools.
